question: If the numerator of a fraction is increased by 10% and its denominator is diminished by 10%, then the fraction becomes (11)/(45) Find the original fraction.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Original Fraction = New Fraction × [(100 − Denominator Change %) ÷ (100 + Numerator Change %)]

Original Fraction = 11/45 × [(100 − 10) ÷ (100 + 10)]

⇒ 11/45 × 90/110

⇒ 11/45 × 9/11

⇒ 1/5

**∴ The correct answer is 1/5.**
